title: Seacrest The MEG Rosemary Beach, Florida 30A Vacay
description_expanded: OverviewHot Tub The MEG – Brand New Luxury Seacrest Home with Private Pool & Lagoon Pool Access!The Space QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Brand New Construction – Modern design & high-end coastal finishes Private Pool (Heat Option Available) – $50/day (October 1 - May 1) – Not guaranteed 5 Adult Bikes Included – Explore Seacrest, Rosemary Beach & Alys Beach Expansive Outdoor Living Spaces – Gas grill, outdoor flatscreen TV & ample seating 4 Master Bedrooms – Each with King bed & private en-suite bath Bunk Room with 4 Twin Beds – Perfect for kids & extra guests Open-Concept Living & Kitchen Area – Fully stocked kitchen & large dining space 12,000 Sq. Ft. Community Lagoon Pool – Resort-style pool just minutes away Free Beach Tram Service – Seasonal tram for easy beach access Shops, Boutiques & Restaurants Within Walking Distance – Prime location in Seacrest Beach Wi-Fi & Smart TVs Throughout – Stay connected & entertained Driveway Parking for 2 Vehicles – Hassle-free & convenient Professionally Managed – 24/7 guest support for a seamless vacation experience Welcome to The MEGThe MEG is a brand new construction home in the heart of Seacrest and is everything you need for the perfect 30A getaway. This neighborhood offers incredible shopping, dining, and scenic charm. Cruise the cobblestone streets by bike and take in everything Seacrest has to offer. You’ll also find convenient tram stops throughout the community providing free seasonal transportation to the beach, along with access to a world-class 12,000 sq ft lagoon-style pool.As you walk into the home, you’re welcomed by a bright, open floor plan with direct views of the private backyard and pool. After a day at the beach, come back and cook your favorite meal in the fully stocked kitchen. The large kitchen island, spacious dining area, and open living room make it easy for everyone to gather without feeling crowded.The living area offers plenty of comfortable seating and overlooks the outdoor space, where you’ll find a private heated pool, outdoor seating,—perfect for relaxing while the kids swim or catching the game outside.The home features four true master bedrooms (yes, four), each with a King bed and private bathroom, plus a bunk room with four twin beds and its own bathroom. This setup is ideal for multiple families or group trips where everyone wants their own space.Come unwind, spread out, and enjoy everything The MEG and Seacrest Beach have to offer.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (12):Master 1: King bed with private bathMaster 2: King bed with private bathMaster 3: King bed with private bathMaster 4: King bed with private bathGuest 5: Bunk room with 4 twin beds, private bathAREA ATTRACTIONS:Seacrest is an ideal place for families and people of all ages. Walk the cobble-stone streets in the Seacrest neighborhood, bike along scenic 30-A, enjoy free concerts and outdoor movies, dine at casual and gourmet restaurants, and let the kids run off to the ice cream parlor or candy store.Seacrest hosts Camp Creek Lake, meaning that ecosploring opportunities abound. Rare bird species can be found along the borders of the lake, which is surrounded by walking trails and made up of a mix of salt and fresh water.This quaint beach neighborhood regularly welcomes new shops and restaurants. Recently opened establishments add an exciting twist to the Seacrest dining scene while long-time favorites keep visitors coming back year after year.Show less
